title: BSD Invariants and Murmurations of Elliptic Curves
summary: We study how the murmurations of elliptic curves over $\mathbb{Q}$ depend on the invariants in the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer formula, using the Frobenius traces at all primes up to $10^5$ for one curve in each isogeny class of conductor below $10^5$. In these data, at the murmuration scale the rank-$0$ profile depends on the central value $L(E,1)$, in its shape and in the position of its sign changes.
